# Carrot seeds

Type: Seed | Internal ID: CarrotSeeds | Source: Carrot plants in the, Black Forest | Usage: Farming | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Produces: 3, Carrots | Grow Time (s): 4000-5000 | Needs Cultivated Ground?: Yes | Space Needed (m): 1 | Hospitable Biomes: Meadows, ,, Black Forest, , and, Plains

# Introduction

Carrot seeds can be planted using the Cultivator in order to grow 1x Carrot.

## Availability

• Carrot seeds are found on the ground in the Black Forest biome. Picked seeds won't respawn.
• Three seeds can be obtained by planting a Carrot using the Cultivator option "Seed-carrot".

Categorias: Seeds, Farming
